mechanism_narrative: The sustained upward trend in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility over the last four weeks indicates a broad return to out-of-home activities, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the average RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the average RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days, despite continued recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: As WORKPLACES mobility approaches -25% from baseline, it signals a critical mass of return-to-office activity that will significantly boost weekday retail and recreation footfall, leading to higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises above -29% but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase compared to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent slight decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility over the last two weeks indicates people are spending less time at home, which directly translates to more opportunities for out-of-home activities, including retail and recreation, over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL mobility continues its decline but RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained positive levels in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM mobility, indicating increased public comfort and activity in diverse settings, will collectively drive a further increase in RETAIL_REC as people extend their out-of-home activities over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: If both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM remain above their specified thresholds but RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days.

candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 10% and RETAIL_REC shows no week-on-week growth
evidence_refs: fact:Decision time point 2021-09-15 implies seasonal change
failure_condition: If PARKS mobility continues to decline below 10% but RETAIL_REC significantly increases over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week decline observed in both RETAIL_REC and PARKS at t-0w, following a period of strong recovery, suggests a temporary plateau or minor reversal in out-of-home activity, leading to a slight decrease in RETAIL_REC over the immediate next week.

failure_condition: If both RETAIL_REC and PARKS fall week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC increases in the subsequent week.

failure_condition: If TRANSIT mobility continues its recovery trend but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days.

This stagnation in return-to-office trends will continue to limit weekday retail foot traffic, preventing significant RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
